title: An Exploration of Small Molecules That Bind Human Single-Stranded DNA Binding Protein 1.
authors: Schuurs, Zachariah P; Martyn, Alexander P; Soltau, Carl P; Beard, Sam; Shah, Esha T; Adams, Mark N; Croft, Laura V; O'Byrne, Kenneth J; Richard, Derek J; Gandhi, Neha S
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟发现靶向hSSB1的小分子，干扰其与ssDNA的结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且含物理模拟方法，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Human single-stranded DNA binding protein 1 (hSSB1) is critical to preserving genome stability, interacting with single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) through an oligonucleotide/oligosaccharide binding-fold. The depletion of hSSB1 in cell-line models leads to aberrant DNA repair and increased sensitivity to irradiation. hSSB1 is over-expressed in several types of cancers, suggesting that hSSB1 could be a novel therapeutic target in malignant disease. hSSB1 binding studies have focused on DNA; however, despite the availability of 3D structures, small molecules targeting hSSB1 have not been explored. Quinoline derivatives targeting hSSB1 were designed through a virtual fragment-based screening process, synthesizing them using AlphaLISA and EMSA to determine their affinity for hSSB1. In parallel, we further screened a structurally diverse compound library against hSSB1 using the same biochemical assays. Three compounds with nanomolar affinity for hSSB1 were identified, exhibiting cytotoxicity in an osteosarcoma cell line. To our knowledge, this is the first study to identify small molecules that modulate hSSB1 activity. Molecular dynamics simulations indicated that three of the compounds that were tested bound to the ssDNA-binding site of hSSB1, providing a framework for the further elucidation of inhibition mechanisms. These data suggest that small molecules can disrupt the interaction between hSSB1 and ssDNA, and may also affect the ability of cells to repair DNA damage. This test study of small molecules holds the potential to provide insights into fundamental biochemical questions regarding the OB-fold.
abstract_zh: 人单链DNA结合蛋白1（hSSB1）对维持基因组稳定性至关重要，通过寡核苷酸/寡糖结合折叠域与单链DNA（ssDNA）相互作用。在细胞系模型中，hSSB1的缺失导致DNA修复异常并增加对辐射的敏感性。hSSB1在多种癌症中过表达，表明hSSB1可能成为恶性疾病的新型治疗靶点。hSSB1结合研究主要集中于DNA；然而，尽管已有3D结构可用，针对hSSB1的小分子尚未被探索。通过虚拟片段筛选过程设计了靶向hSSB1的喹啉衍生物，并使用AlphaLISA和EMSA合成它们以测定其对hSSB1的亲和力。同时，我们使用相同的生化测定法进一步筛选了针对hSSB1的结构多样性化合物库。鉴定出三种对hSSB1具有纳摩尔亲和力的化合物，在骨肉瘤细胞系中表现出细胞毒性。据我们所知，这是首次识别调节hSSB1活性小分子的研究。分子动力学模拟表明，测试的三种化合物结合到hSSB1的ssDNA结合位点，为进一步阐明抑制机制提供了框架。这些数据表明，小分子可以破坏hSSB1与ssDNA之间的相互作用，并可能影响细胞修复DNA损伤的能力。这项小分子测试研究有望为OB折叠域的基本生化问题提供见解。
